name: Sanje Waterfalls, Udzungwa Mountains
why: Rainforest of the Eastern Arc mountains, home of rare red colobus monkeys, to the 170 m Sanje falls and a pool at the top.
book: Udzungwa Mountains National Park fees and a park guide at the Mang'ula headquarters.
dangers: Steep and slippery in the rain.

points.name: Sanje village
points.note: The village and trailhead on the road at the foot of the mountains.

points.name: Sanje Waterfalls
points.note: A long waterfall that drops off the escarpment in several steps.
